prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [home, redesign] Interactive waiting tips during pet generation: Redesign the waiting screen into a stage layout with a tip carousel to keep users engaged while generation completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "stage", "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Discover desktop pet tricks and shortcuts while your pet is generated.", "style": "playful"}]}}
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in step after home intro: Shift the sign-in screen to occur right after home intro so users experience their active pet before creating an account.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "sign_in"]}
2: [choose_path, redesign] Spotlight path selection layout: Redesign the choose path screen into a spotlight layout to highlight pet adoption paths clearly.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Choose How to Create Your Pet", "body": "Pick from ready-made pet companions or upload photos to build a custom pet."}}
3: [adoption, redesign] Stage layout redesign for adoption certificate: Redesign the adoption certificate screen with a stage layout and visual preview of the adopted pet.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage", "components": [{"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:pet_preview_stage", "style": "rounded"}]}}
4: [adoption, copy] Photo upload guidance copy update: Update headline and body on upload photos screen with clear photo lighting and pose recommendations.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"headline": "Upload Clear Pet Photos", "body": "Use clear, well-lit photos facing forward for optimal 3D pet generation results.", "hint": "Avoid heavy shadows or blurry images."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Time estimate and ready notification on waiting screen: Enable time estimates and background ready notification toggles during pet generation waiting.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Feel free to minimize; we will notify you as soon as your pet is ready."}}
6: [sign_in, hint] Sign-in device sync hint: Add a hint on sign-in clarifying that signing in protects pets from being lost across logins.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in secures your active pets and syncs them to your account."}}
7: [adoption, layout] Grid layout for pick friend screen: Change the pick friend screen layout to a structured grid view.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid"}}
8: [finish, copy] Desktop control instructions on home intro: Add explicit instructions to home intro body copy explaining how to interact with and hide the pet via system tray.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Active on Your Desktop!", "body": "Click your pet to interact, or right-click its icon in the system tray to hide or adjust settings.", "hint": "System tray icon allows hiding and toggling pet visibility anytime."}}
9: [adoption, incentive] Mascot badge on adoption certificate: Add a mascot celebration badge component to the adoption certificate screen.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:mascot_welcome", "style": "playful", "action": "next"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesign keeps the waiting screen job of showing pet generation in progress.
Reordering sign-in after home intro is permitted under Rule 4.
Redesign retains both adopting ready-made pets and creating a custom pet.
Redesign replaces certificate components with preview only, losing the required official stamp.
Valid copy update providing photo guidelines without breaking rules.
Time estimate for a real generation wait is permitted under Rule 5.
Valid sign-in hint addition inside onboarding.
Valid grid layout change for pick friend screen.
Valid copy update for home intro explaining desktop controls.
Adding a new mascot component to adoption certificate is allowed.
